name: The Echo Mask
notes: DRAFT for C13-6 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). Red-Black Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases (66% and 33%, Manager's call). Stats are TODO for the Researcher. Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey.

attacks.name: echo copy
attacks.note: Repeats your last move as a soft red circle where you stood.

phases.tell: The mask tilts back; red circle.
phases.senseiLine: Watch the mask, not the echo.

phases.tell: Your own move echoes back where you stood.
phases.senseiLine: It copies you. Choose your own way.

phases.tell: A striped lane and double marks.
phases.senseiLine: Your choice, not the echo's. DASH.

lines.intro: Your own steps echo back. Who is copying whom?
lines.freed: I copied what I heard. Now I hear kindness.
lines.senseiAfter: You chose your own words, not the echo's.

description: The Echo Mask swipes, copies your last move back at you, then sends a striped echo down a lane.

bestiary.tip: It copies you. Keep moving and choose your path.

lore.red-black: A floating mask that copies your moves. Under the mask, it is lonely. Free it, and its light comes home.
